title: A stabilized enrichment method for rosemary diterpenoids and their therapeutic potential
author: Wei, Jiali
materials: Methanol, formic acid, and acetonitrile were purchased from Sigma-Aldrich (Shanghai, China). Vitamin C, ethanol, and phosphoric acid were obtained from Sinopharm Group Chemical Reagent (Shanghai, China). Milli-Q Water was prepared using a Milli-Q water purification system (USA).

Total RNA was isolated from sample using Trizol reagents (Vazyme, China) and reverse transcribed into cDNA using HiScript Reverse Transcriptase kit (Vazyme, China). Quantitative real-time PCR using SYBR Green Master Mix (Vazyme, China) was performed with Light-Cycler 480 (Roche Diagnostics GmbH). The primer sequences used in this study are listed in Table S7.

The C57BL/6J mice were randomly divided into the standard chow diet (Jiangsu synergetic biology, 1,010,039) group and the high fat diet (HFD, 60% fat, Research Diets, D12492) group. After exposure for 4 weeks to the respective diets, the HFD-fed mice were injected intraperitoneally with 40 mg/kg streptozocin (STZ, Sigma-Aldrich) solution after overnight fasting for 5 consecutive days. The chow group received the vehicle only. After 7 days, the HFD/STZ mice with fasting blood glucose levels ≥ 16.7 mM were induced successfully. Mice were randomly divided into 5 groups, with 10 mice in each group, as follows: (i) NC group (normal mice treated with 0.5% CMC-Na); (ii) DKD group (DKD mice treated with 0.5% CMC-Na); (iii) DKD + Dap group (DKD mice treated with dapagliflozin); (iv) DKD + TDL group (DKD mice treated with 25 mg/kg TD); and (v) DKD + TDH group (DKD mice treated with 50 mg/kg TD). The treatments were administered once daily for 10 weeks. The dosages of TD were chosen based on previous studies [4]. The dosage of dapagliflozin was calculated by body surface area normalization method (Meeh-Rubner formula).

Mice kidney tissues were lysed on ice in RIPA (Beyotime, Shanghai, China) buffer with protease inhibitors (Roche, Shanghai, China), followed by 10 min of centrifugation at 12,000 g at 4 °C to obtain the supernatant. Protein concentration was determined by a protein quantification (BCA protein assay kit, Jiancheng, Nanjing, China). Protein (20 μg/lane) was electrophoresed on 10% SDS polyacrylamide gel (Servicebio, Wuhan, China) and transferred to a 0.22 μm NC membrane (Millipore, USA), then blocked with 5% bovine serum albumin for 1 h. After washing with TBST thrice, all membranes were incubated overnight with the following primary antibodies: Nrf2 (1:1000, Cell signaling Technology, 12,721), HO-1 (1:5000, proteintech, 10,701–1-AP), and β-actin (1:1000, proteintech, 66,009–1-Ig). They were then incubated with secondary antibodies at ambient temperature for 1 h. Quantification was performed using the ECL kit (Abbkine, Wuhan, China).

steps.title: Prepare solvents and water
steps.instruction: Obtain methanol, formic acid, acetonitrile (Sigma‑Aldrich, Shanghai), vitamin C, ethanol, phosphoric acid (Sinopharm, Shanghai) and prepare Milli‑Q water using a Milli‑Q purification system (USA).

steps.title: Obtain reference standards
steps.instruction: Purchase standards of carnosol, rosmanol, rosmarinic acid, homoplantaginin, cirsimaritin, 12‑metoxy‑carnosic acid (Chengdu Must Biotechnology), apigenin, hispidulin, epirosmanol, genkwanin, pectolinarigenin, bergenin, betulinic acid (Chengdu Push Biotechnology), and carnosic acid (Chengdu Pufei De Biotech).

steps.title: Extract and partition rosemary leaves
steps.instruction: Buy dried rosemary leaves (Bozhou Traditional Chinese Medicine Market) and store in the dark at 26 °C ± 5 °C for 24 h; authenticate the material. Perform two successive extractions with 95 % ethanol at 90 °C, concentrate the filtrate, lyophilize to obtain a crude residue (Fraction‑1). Sequentially partition Fraction‑1 with water to give Fraction‑2 and with cyclohexane to give Fraction‑3; the remaining residue is Fraction‑4.

steps.title: Single‑factor extraction screening
steps.instruction: Investigate extraction method, ethanol concentration, solid‑to‑liquid ratio, temperature, heat‑reflux time and number of cycles; measure diterpenoid content in each extract to identify optimal conditions.

steps.title: Orthogonal experiment for phenolic‑acid removal
steps.instruction: First perform single‑factor tests to screen critical factors for phenolic‑acid removal, then conduct an L9 (3³) orthogonal array (factors: washing method A, solid‑to‑liquid ratio B, washing cycles C) to determine optimal washing conditions (see Tables S1 and S2).

steps.title: Dilute extracts with ethanol and filter
steps.instruction: Dilute the extracts with ethanol solution, filter to remove triterpenoids, evaluating ethanol concentration and solid‑to‑liquid ratio; determine optimal conditions by measuring yield and content of carnosic acid and the peak area of betulinic acid.

steps.title: Prepare test solution for UPLC
steps.instruction: Dilute extracts and reference standards with methanol to 0.1 mg mL⁻¹, centrifuge at 13 000 rpm for 5 min, and store the supernatant at 4 °C as the test solution.

steps.title: Configure and run UPLC‑QTOF qualitative analysis
steps.instruction: Use an Agilent 1290 Infinity UPLC coupled to a 6530 Q‑TOF. Column: Agilent Zorbax Eclipse Plus C18 (2.1 × 100 mm, 1.8 µm). Gradient (A = 0.1 % formic acid in water, B = acetonitrile): 0 min 5 % B, 2 min 15 % B, 13 min 60 % B, 18 min 60 % B, 19 min 80 % B, 27 min 95 % B, 27.5 min 95 % B, 28.5 min 5 % B, 33 min 5 % B. Flow = 0.4 mL min⁻¹, injection = 1 µL, column = 30 °C. MS: negative ESI, capillary = 3500 V, fragmentor = 120 V, nebulizer = 35 psi, drying gas = 350 °C at 10 L min⁻¹, sheath gas = 350 °C, collision energies 20 V and 40 V, scan = m/z 100‑1500, auto‑MS/MS = m/z 100‑1000.

steps.title: Prepare extracts and standards for quantification
steps.instruction: Dissolve 10.00 mg of each extract in 25 mL methanol, centrifuge at 13 000 rpm for 5 min, and store supernatant at 4 °C. Prepare reference standards at 1 mg mL⁻¹ in methanol and dilute to the concentration ranges listed in Table S4.

steps.title: Run quantitative UPLC‑DAD analysis
steps.instruction: Use the same Agilent 1290 Infinity UPLC system with a diode‑array detector. Apply the chromatographic conditions described for qualitative analysis. Inject 2 µL, detect at 284 nm, and quantify compounds by external standard curves (Excel).

steps.title: Calculate extraction yield
steps.instruction: Compute X (%) = M × C / (M₀ × C₀) × 100, where M is mass of extracted TD (g), C is % content of carnosic acid and carnosol in the extract, M₀ is dried rosemary mass (g), and C₀ is % content of carnosic acid and carnosol in the raw leaves.

steps.title: Stability study of carnosic acid
steps.instruction: Investigate effects of phosphoric acid, formic acid, and vitamin C on carnosic‑acid stability in TD solution; optimize vitamin C concentration; store TD solution for one month at 4 °C, 25 °C and 50 °C and assess carnosic‑acid content; perform UPLC‑Q/TOF‑MS on samples with/without vitamin C after 30 days.

steps.title: Culture and stimulate HK2 cells
steps.instruction: Grow HK2 cells in MEM with 10 % FBS, 100 µg mL⁻¹ streptomycin, 100 µg mL⁻¹ penicillin at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂. Stimulate with 30 mM high glucose and 200 µM palmitic acid, with or without extracts at 8 µg mL⁻¹, for 24 h.

steps.title: Assess HK2 viability with CCK‑8
steps.instruction: Seed 1 × 10⁴ HK2 cells per well in 96‑well plates, incubate 24 h, treat with varying extract concentrations for 24 h, discard media, add 100 µL (90 µL cell media + 10 µL CCK‑8 solution, Abbkine), incubate 0.5 h, read absorbance at 450 nm.

steps.title: Extract lipids and measure TG/TC
steps.instruction: Harvest cells from 6‑well plates in 1 mL PBS. Transfer 100 µL to a tube, centrifuge 1000 × g, 5 min, 4 °C; lyse pellet for protein quantification (BCA). Use remaining suspension for lipid extraction: add 200 µL chloroform/methanol (2:1 v/v), shake 3 h at 24 °C, add 100 µL 0.1 M NaCl, mix, centrifuge 3700 rpm, 10 min. Collect lower organic phase, evaporate, re‑suspend residue in 10 µL 1 % Triton X‑100 in anhydrous ethanol, determine TG and TC with commercial kits (Jiancheng).

steps.title: Isolate RNA and perform qPCR
steps.instruction: Extract total RNA with Trizol (Vazyme), reverse‑transcribe using HiScript Reverse Transcriptase (Vazyme), amplify with SYBR Green Master Mix (Vazyme) on a Light‑Cycler 480 (Roche). Use primer sequences listed in Table S7.

steps.title: Assign mice to diet and treatment groups
steps.instruction: Randomly allocate C57BL/6J mice to standard chow (Jiangsu synergetic biology, cat #1,010,039) or high‑fat diet (60 % fat, Research Diets, D12492) for 4 weeks. Then inject HFD mice intraperitoneally with 40 mg kg⁻¹ streptozotocin (STZ, Sigma‑Aldrich) after overnight fasting for 5 consecutive days. After 7 days, select mice with fasting glucose ≥ 16.7 mM. Randomly divide into five groups (n = 10): NC (0.5 % CMC‑Na), DKD (0.5 % CMC‑Na), DKD + Dap (dapagliflozin), DKD + TDL (25 mg kg⁻¹ TD), DKD + TDH (50 mg kg⁻¹ TD). Administer treatments once daily for 10 weeks (TD dose based on prior studies; dapagliflozin dose calculated by Meeh‑Rubner body‑surface‑area method).

steps.title: Collect and analyze blood and urine
steps.instruction: At study end, measure fasting blood glucose with a glucometer (Sinocare). Collect 24‑h urine, centrifuge, and assay urinary albumin, micro‑albumin, and creatinine (Jiancheng). Analyze serum for creatinine, BUN, TG, TC, LDL‑C, HDL‑C (Jiancheng). Determine MDA, SOD, and GSH‑Px using Bioswamp kits.

steps.title: 14‑day oral dosing and organ harvest
steps.instruction: Purchase 8‑week‑old Balb/c mice (half male, half female) from Charles River (Pinghu). Randomly assign to six groups (n = 10 per group, 5 M/5 F). Give a single oral dose of TD; monitor for 14 days. On day 14, euthanize survivors, excise heart, liver, spleen, lungs, kidneys, and small intestine, and fix for H&E histology.

steps.title: Perform ITT and OGTT
steps.instruction: After the 10‑week intervention, conduct insulin tolerance test: inject insulin i.p. at 0.75 IU kg⁻¹ and measure blood glucose from venous bleed at 0, 30, 60, 90, 120 min. Three days later, perform oral glucose tolerance test: give oral glucose 2 g kg⁻¹ and measure glucose at 0, 15, 30, 60, 90, 120 min. Calculate area under the curve for each test.

steps.title: Process kidney tissue for histology
steps.instruction: Remove kidneys, rinse in precooled saline, fix half in 4 % paraformaldehyde for 48 h, embed in paraffin, cut sections, and stain with H&E, PAS, and Masson trichrome. Capture images with an OLYMPUS IX73 microscope.

steps.title: Prepare and run Western blot
steps.instruction: Lyse kidney tissue on ice in RIPA buffer (Beyotime) with protease inhibitors (Roche), centrifuge 12 000 g, 10 min, 4 °C, collect supernatant. Determine protein concentration (BCA, Jiancheng). Load 20 µg protein per lane on 10 % SDS‑PAGE (Servicebio), transfer to 0.22 µm NC membrane (Millipore), block 5 % BSA 1 h, wash 3× with TBST, incubate overnight at 4 °C with primary antibodies: Nrf2 (1:1000, Cell Signaling 12,721), HO‑1 (1:5000, Proteintech 10,701‑1‑AP), β‑actin (1:1000, Proteintech 66,009‑1‑Ig). Incubate with HRP‑conjugated secondary antibodies 1 h at room temperature, develop with ECL kit (Abbkine).

steps.title: Statistical analysis
steps.instruction: Express data as mean ± SEM. Compare groups by one‑way ANOVA with Dunnett’s post‑test (≥ 3 independent experiments). Perform analysis with GraphPad Prism 10.3.1; consider P < 0.05 significant.
